title: Meet Data Link
summary: Recruiters can learn important information on almost every candidate and client call. But remembering to transfer it all into the CRM afterwards is another story.
body_markdown:
🔗 Meet[Data Link](https://devyce.com/data-link)


Recruiters capture valuable information on almost every candidate and client call.


But getting that information into the CRM afterwards can mean time-consuming manual updates, and important details possbily being missed.


Data Link is here to bridge that gap.


It extracts relevant information from calls and turns it into suggested CRM field updates, helping recruiters capture what matters while keeping control over what gets added to the CRM.


Is valuable CRM data getting lost between calls?


👇 Check out Data Link in our video below!


‍


Recruiters can learn important information on almost every candidate and client call. But remembering to transfer it all into the CRM afterwards is another story.


We’ll demonstrate how with Data Link, you can:


• Extract relevant information from calls


• Capture it as structured CRM data


• Updates CRM fields in seconds


‍


Plus, your recruiters will retain complete control over what gets added!


See firsthand how Devyce can help connect what’s said on the call with the information stored in your CRM.


‍


Capture every conversation. Extract what matters. Automatically update your CRM.


Join Amirah Miller and George Markham as they reveal Devyce's latest feature Data Link in this[Webinar](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devyce_capture-every-conversation-extract-what-activity-7513535681537699840-uelv?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAACaCO0cBGipLbqgPwsm_CcQx4v6djBveU14) .
